put.summary: Replace the three permitted own-profile fields

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exact configured browser application origin, including scheme/port; mandatory even when Fetch Metadata is absent.

parameters.name: Sec-Fetch-Site
parameters.description: cross-site rejected. same-site/same-origin/none require exact Origin; absent metadata does not bypass Origin/custom-header checks.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Existing current-session-derived CSRF token.

requestBody.description: Strict flat JSON <=16384 bytes, identity content encoding only; all three fields required, unknown/duplicate keys rejected.

displayName.description: 1–160 Unicode scalar values; no outer whitespace, C0/C1 controls or unpaired surrogates. Not normalized.

dateOfBirth.description: Null or valid calendar YYYY-MM-DD, years 0001–9999. Profile context only; no age/applicability assertion or future-date inference.

sex.description: Null or 1–64 Unicode scalar values; same whitespace/control/surrogate restrictions as displayName. Opaque context; no clinical interpretation.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-eh_session
sessionCookie.description: Production HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax Path=/ host-only cookie. Local development/test uses eh_session without Secure.

csrfToken.description: Session-bound CSRF value; never a session credential.

email.description: EH-005 bounded ASCII canonicalization; maximum 1024 UTF-8 bytes before normalization.

password.description: Unmodified UTF-8 password, 1–1024 bytes; never silently truncated.

systolic.description: Technical int32 limits only; no clinical plausibility claim.

measuredAt.description: UTC instant serialized with exactly three fractional digits.

createdAt.description: UTC instant serialized with exactly three fractional digits.

systolic.description: Technical int32 limits only; no clinical plausibility claim.

measuredAt.description: Real Gregorian date, years 0001..9999 both before/after UTC normalization. Seconds and timezone required. -00:00, leap seconds, 24:00, whitespace, excess precision and future instants rejected. Backdated readings allowed.

scheduledAt.description: UTC instant serialized with exactly three fractional digits.

createdAt.description: UTC instant serialized with exactly three fractional digits.

occurredAt.description: UTC instant serialized with exactly three fractional digits.

createdAt.description: UTC instant serialized with exactly three fractional digits.
UTC instant serialized with exactly three fractional digits.

scheduledAt.description: Real Gregorian offset-bearing instant; years 0001..9999 before/after normalization; 0..3 fractional digits. No whitespace, -00:00, leap seconds or 24:00. Must be strictly future relative to database receipt time.

occurredAt.description: Real Gregorian offset-bearing instant; years 0001..9999 before/after normalization; 0..3 fractional digits. No whitespace, -00:00, leap seconds or 24:00. Backdating allowed; cannot exceed database receipt time.

email.description: Request representation <=1024 UTF8 bytes before canonicalization; outer ASCII SP/HT/LF/VT/FF/CR trimmed, ASCII lowercased, printable nonwhitespace ASCII, exactly one @ with nonempty parts. No dot/plus/provider folding or Unicode addresses.

password.description: 1–1024 UTF8 bytes, unmodified/untrimmed; existing Argon2id codec and login semantics. Byte limit overrides character count.

displayName.description: 1–160 Unicode scalar values; no outer whitespace, C0/C1 controls or unpaired surrogates. Not normalized.

id.description: Server-derived own patient_profiles.id locator for existing scoped resources; never authority or a permitted PUT input.

displayName.description: Existing stored own display text. New writes use the bounded PUT contract; historical context is not rewritten.

dateOfBirth.description: Existing PostgreSQL ISO date text, including legacy years outside new-write bounds; null remains unknown. Historical context is preserved without backfill or truncation.

sex.description: Existing opaque own context; no clinical interpretation. New writes use bounded PUT validation.
